const ll M = 1000000007;

ll p, k;

vector<int> visited;

int visit(int x) {
    int count = 1;
    visited[x] = 1;
    while (!visited[(x * k) % p]) {
        x = (x * k) % p;
        count++;
        visited[x] = 1;
    }
    return count;
}

ll power(ll base, ll exponent) {
    ll result = 1;
    while (exponent > 0) {
        if (exponent & 1) result = (result * base) % p;
        base = (base * base) % p;
        exponent >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    cin >> p >> k;
    visited.assign(p, 0);
    ll answer = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        if (!visited[i]) {
            int size = visit(i);
            ll t = power(k, size);
            if (t != 1 && t != 0)
                answer = (answer * (size + 1)) % M;
            else
                answer = (answer * p) % M;
        }
    }
    if (k == 1) answer = (answer * p) % M;
    cout << answer << endl;
}
